**All eight problems remain open.** This is the public coordination point for anyone deciding whether and where to contribute.

The working copy is **`main` and the mathematics site**, not a tagged ZIP. Start with the [mathematics site](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis/maths/). In the repository, read [A reader's way in](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-erdos/blob/main/docs/READING_GUIDE.md), then [RESULTS](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-erdos/blob/main/docs/RESULTS.md) for the strongest checked progress and the exact obligation still open in each programme.

[`v0.10.0`](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-erdos/releases/tag/v0.10.0) is a frozen 11 September 2026 snapshot for citing that edition. It does not move when papers, Lean, or RESULTS change. Do not download those release PDFs as the current frontier.

## Want a smaller first task?

[Independently reproduce one checked claim](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-erdos/issues/106). It takes Git and Python 3, not Lean, and a clean pass or a concrete defect are both useful outcomes.

## Useful contributions

A useful contribution can be a proof or Lean lemma, but it can also be a counterexample to an intermediate claim, a correction, a missing source, an independent reproduction, a sharper explanation, or a small computation tied to a stated open obligation.

Open a focused issue using the appropriate repository form and include the exact claim or problem, the evidence, and the boundary of what your contribution establishes. [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-erdos/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains the evidence and credit path.

If this repository materially helps produce a solution, the solution and its credit belong to the solver. Cite the commit or tagged edition you actually used, and say that Plectis helped.
